full_judgment: 5. The Rule Nisi was issued in the following terms : "Let the records of the case be called for and a Rule nisi be issued calling upon the respondents to show cause as to why the judgment and decree dated 15.02.2016 passed by the Judge, Arpita Sampatti Prattarpon Appeal Tribunal, Sylhet (Annexure-D) in Arpita Sampatti Appeal No.144 of 2015 dismissing the appeal and thereby upholding the judgment and decree dated 06.07.2012 passed by the Judge of the Arpita Sampatti Prattarpon Tribunal and Joint District Judge, Sylhet decreeing the Arpita Sampatti Prattarpon Case No.142 of 2012 should not be declared to have been passed without lawful authority and is of no legal effect, and/or such other or further order or orders passed as to this Court may seem fit and proper."
